scripts.build: pnpm --filter @nba-draft-sim/shared build && pnpm --filter nba-draft-sim-client build && pnpm --filter nba-draft-sim-server build
scripts.format: pnpm --filter nba-draft-sim-client exec eslint . --ext ts,tsx --report-unused-disable-directives --max-warnings 0 --fix-dry-run && pnpm --filter nba-draft-sim-server exec eslint . --ext ts --report-unused-disable-directives --max-warnings 0 --fix-dry-run
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter nba-draft-sim-client lint && pnpm --filter nba-draft-sim-server lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @nba-draft-sim/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @nba-draft-sim/shared build && pnpm --filter nba-draft-sim-client typecheck && pnpm --filter nba-draft-sim-server typecheck
scripts.pre-pr: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
